feedback.title: Quiet luxury done right
feedback.body: I've used this every day for three months. The leather has softened beautifully and the inner pockets fit my 14" laptop and a journal without bulk. Worth every rupee.

feedback.title: Great hardware, app is fiddly
feedback.body: Battery lasts almost a week and heart-rate is accurate against my Polar strap. First-run pairing with the iOS app took three tries. Once paired it's been rock solid.
feedback.reply: Thanks Nora — the pairing flow is getting an overhaul in next month's app release. We'll let you know when it ships.

feedback.title: Right earbud cuts out on calls
feedback.body: Music playback is fine but the right earbud drops audio whenever I'm on a Zoom or phone call. I've tried two phones and a laptop. Otherwise the fit and sound are great.

feedback.title: Sculptural and warm
feedback.body: Bought two — one for the bedroom and one for the studio. The dimmer warmth is exactly right and the base is heavier than I expected, which I appreciate.

feedback.title: My new go-to spring layer
feedback.body: Drapes well, the linen is heavyweight enough to hold its shape, and the buttons feel substantial. Sizing ran true for me — I'm normally a M and the M fit perfectly.
feedback.reply: Olivia — thrilled to hear it. Tag us if you ever post a photo of it in the wild.

feedback.title: Fantastic switches, software is rough
feedback.body: The keys feel incredible — typing on it is genuinely a pleasure. The macro configurator on the Mac app crashes when I try to remap function keys though.

feedback.title: Holds its own against the big names
feedback.body: Took it diving in the Maldives and the footage is gorgeous. Stabilization is shockingly good for the price point.
feedback.reply: Felix — that's amazing. If you ever want to share clips for our gallery, hit hello@intellicart.shop.

feedback.title: Soft but shrinks on hot wash
feedback.body: Cotton is lovely and the drape is exactly the oversized fit I wanted. Lost about a size after one accidental hot wash though — wish the care label was more prominent.

feedback.title: Made my commute bearable
feedback.body: ANC is class-leading. I used them on a 12-hour flight to Lagos and they blocked engine noise completely without the usual ear fatigue.
feedback.reply: Aisha — really glad to hear that. Safe travels, and thanks for taking the time to write this up.

feedback.title: Fast and pocketable
feedback.body: Sustained writes match the spec. The braided USB-C cable is a nice touch — feels much more durable than the rubber ones from the last brand I tried.

feedback.title: Stopped charging after 3 weeks
feedback.body: Loved the sound for the first three weeks. Now it won't take a charge from any cable. Reached out to support and waiting to hear back.

feedback.title: Exactly what I hoped for
feedback.body: The weight and weave are gorgeous. It's become the centerpiece of the living room and feels like it'll last decades.
feedback.reply: Elena — that's lovely to hear, thank you for taking the time.

feedback.title: Comfortable but sizing runs small
feedback.body: Wish I'd ordered a half size up. Comfort once they broke in is excellent, but the first week was rough on my pinky toes.

feedback.title: Heirloom quality
feedback.body: Weighty, beautifully finished, and feels like something I'll hand down. The juice groove is deep enough to actually catch liquid from a tomato.
feedback.reply: Camille — that's wonderful, thank you. Don't forget to oil it every few months.

feedback.title: Cozy and well-made
feedback.body: Soft against the forehead, no itching. Slightly snug at first but stretched to a perfect fit after a couple of wears.

feedback.title: Plush after a wash or two
feedback.body: First wash was needed to bring out the absorbency, but they've been excellent since. Color held up beautifully through six wash cycles so far.

feedback.title: Worth the splurge
feedback.body: Impossibly soft and the dye saturation is gorgeous. Pilled slightly on the first wear but smoothed out with a quick comb.
feedback.reply: Priya — thank you for the second review this month, we appreciate the loyalty!

feedback.title: Two bulbs flicker on dim
feedback.body: Setup was easy and the color tuning is great. Two of the four flicker noticeably below 30% brightness though — hoping support can swap them.

feedback.title: Stunning piece, packed beautifully
feedback.body: Arrived without a scratch despite a long international shipping window. The light catches it differently throughout the day — really special.

feedback.title: Beautiful drape, hem ran long
feedback.body: The fabric and pleats are perfect. Had to take an inch off the hem — would love an inseam option at checkout.

feedback.title: Great for daily carry
feedback.body: Slim enough to not look bulky, fits a 13" laptop and notebook. Would love a dedicated pen slot inside.
feedback.reply: Alex — noted on the pen slot, passed it to the design team for the next iteration.

feedback.title: Replaced my Apple Watch
feedback.body: Battery and sleep tracking are a generational leap. The strap quick-release is a small detail I love.

feedback.title: Beautifully made
feedback.body: Holds six cards comfortably and a folded note. The leather smell when it arrived was glorious.
